title: coverage.mjs supports explicit monorepo coverage.targets
goal: Let a monorepo declare explicit per-workspace coverage targets that coverage.mjs runs and aggregates correctly, instead of only auto-detecting a single root-level stack.
in_scope: resolveWithinRoot(relPath, label): resolve cwd/summary/lcov relative to root, exit 2 on path traversal outside the repo
targetStack(t): build a stack descriptor per target (resolvable/run/report/reportFormat/reportPath), exit 2 on a malformed target entry
Wire coverage.targets into ALL_STACKS ahead of the coverage.command and auto-detect fallbacks, preserving both when targets is absent
Confirm --stack (from S-2) can select exactly one target by id
No change needed to the aggregate math (coveredSum/totalSum is already weighted) -- this story only needs a regression test proving it
out_of_scope: Any new coverage-tool backend beyond istanbul-style json-summary reading (already supported)
coverage.mjs --setup support for targets (not required by the spec; YAGNI)
acceptance: Two workspace targets with different report sizes run and aggregate by weighted covered/measurable lines, not an unweighted average; a failing target command or missing declared report fails closed; target paths cannot escape the repository root; --stack can select exactly one target; single-root auto-detection is unchanged when coverage.targets is absent.
invariants: Every configured target runs and is recorded in .throughline/coverage/summary.json unless --stack narrows to one
A target's cwd is used as the working directory for its command (not the repo root)
